main_text.p: guantur. Res hæc me non pa-rum suspensum & dubium te-nuit. Nam ex una parte quò-minus ipsorum consilio locus dandus videretur, invidiæ & malignitatis metus obstabat, quam haud dubiè magis, quàm antehac incursurus essem apud novandi & turbandi cu-pidos, ideò, quod tàm pul-chris & heroicis scilicet ipsorum ausibus impedimento essem. Ex altera parte atrocitas ipsa moliminis me avocabat, quæ a-lios ad resistendum animare so-let. Cogitabam enim, cùm res non solum Religionis, sed etiam

page.notes: The first word "guantur." is a fragment from the previous page and is kept as such; the "g" is a long-s-style initial as printed. The page number "3" is printed in parentheses-like marks "(?)3" at the foot; the leading mark is doubtful and may be a printer's or scan mark, so only "3" is recorded. No marginal notes or catchword are visible. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept. Scan spots and blotches are not transcribed.
